lines.t: Verse 1
Skies grow cold, lights grow dim
They call my name, but I won’t give in
Every voice tries pulling me away
But I hear You louder every day
Pre-Chorus 1
I feel the pull, I feel the weight
But I won’t trade truth for something fake
Chorus
Everything around me feels so cold,
So hold me in Your arms, and don’t let go.
I don’t want to fit in with the world,
All I want is You, all I want is You.
Even when the skies are turning gray,
Your warmth is where I choose to stay.
Verse 2
I walk through noise, I walk through rain
But I won’t carry what brings me pain
The world keeps shifting like the tide
But You’re the place I can always hide
Pre-Chorus 2
I hear the noise, I feel the strain
But Your love breaks through every chain
I won’t drift, I won’t fade away
Your voice is what I choose to obey
Chorus
Everything around me feels so cold,
So hold me in Your arms, and don’t let go.
I don’t want to fit in with the world,
All I want is You, all I want is You.
Even when the skies are turning gray,
Your warmth is where I choose to stay.
Bridge
I don’t need the world’s approval
I don’t need their perfect view
All I need is Your presence
All I need is You
When everything is falling silent
When nothing else feels true
I find my peace, I find my home
In the warmth I feel in You
Everything around me still feels cold,
But I’m held in Your arms and You won’t let go.
I don’t want to fit in with the world,
All I want is You, still all I want is You.
Even when the skies are turning gray,
Your warmth is where I’ll always stay.
Your warmth is where I’ll always stay.
